heading: Coordination with Secretary of Transportation
lead: In implementing this part with respect to air carriers, the Secretary shall coordinate with the Secretary of Transportation.

notes.text: References in TextThis part, referred to in text, was in the original “this subtitle”, meaning subtitle A (§§ 4001–4029) of title IV of div. A of Pub. L. 116–136, which is classified principally to this part. For complete classification of subtitle A to the Code, see section 4001 of Pub. L. 116–136, set out as a Short Title note under section 9001 of this title, and Tables.
